mechanism: Bumetanide causes hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia which can be worsened by esomeprazole's inhibition of magnesium absorption; additionally, esomeprazole may increase bumetanide levels through CYP2C19 inhibition.
action: Monitor serum potassium and magnesium levels regularly; consider magnesium supplementation and increased frequency of electrolyte monitoring when used concurrently.
